zh.principle: **协议**：DTLS 1.2（DTLS 1.2）。摘要给出定位：「This document specifies version 1.2 of the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) protocol.The DTLS protocol provides communications privacy for datagram protocols.」并说明「This document updates DTLS 1.0 to work with TLS version 1.2.」
zh.why: 版本号的对齐策略写在 §1：「There is no DTLS 1.1; that version number was skipped in order to harmonize version numbers with TLS.」算法层则直接继承 TLS 1.2——§4.1.2.4 说明「The existing AEAD cipher suites, defined in [ECCGCM] and [RSAGCM], can be used with DTLS exactly as with TLS 1.2.」
zh.used: 与 TLS 最大的行为差异是容错：§4.1.2.7 规定无效记录「In general, invalid records SHOULD be silently discarded, thus preserving the association; however, an error MAY be logged for diagnostic purposes.」记录层本身则与 TLS 1.2 几乎相同，「The only change is the inclusion of an explicit sequence number in the record.」
zh.broken: 选择告警的代价被明确劝阻：实现若对无效记录产生告警，「MUST generate fatal level alerts to avoid attacks where the attacker repeatedly probes the implementation to see how it responds to various types of error.」，而在 UDP 上「this practice is NOT RECOMMENDED for such transports.」§4.1 另要求 epoch 与序号唯一——「implementations MUST NOT allow the same epoch value to be reused within two times the TCP maximum segment lifetime.」
zh.history:
RFC 6347 头部为 E.Rescorla（RTFM, Inc.）与 N.Modadugu（Google, Inc.），类别 Standards Track，2012 年 1 月，带 ISSN 行并标注「Obsoletes: 4347」，没有 Updates 行；§8 的「Changes since DTLS 1.0」把与 TLS 1.2 对齐、AEAD 一节的加入等改动逐项列出。

en.principle: **Protocol**: DTLS 1.2 (DTLS 1.2). The abstract sets the scope: "This document specifies version 1.2 of the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) protocol. The DTLS protocol provides communications privacy for datagram protocols." and adds "This document updates DTLS 1.0 to work with TLS version 1.2."
en.why: Section 1 explains the numbering: "There is no DTLS 1.1; that version number was skipped in order to harmonize version numbers with TLS." The algorithm layer inherits TLS 1.2 outright — §4.1.2.4 says "The existing AEAD cipher suites, defined in [ECCGCM] and [RSAGCM], can be used with DTLS exactly as with TLS 1.2."
en.used:
The behavioural difference from TLS is fault tolerance: §4.1.2.7 says "In general, invalid records SHOULD be silently discarded, thus preserving the association; however, an error MAY be logged for diagnostic purposes." The record layer itself is near-identical, "The only change is the inclusion of an explicit sequence number in the record."

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: Choosing alerts is actively discouraged: such implementations "MUST generate fatal level alerts to avoid attacks where the attacker repeatedly probes the implementation to see how it responds to various types of error.", and over UDP "this practice is NOT RECOMMENDED for such transports." Section 4.1 adds that "implementations MUST NOT allow the same epoch value to be reused within two times the TCP maximum segment lifetime."
en.history: The RFC 6347 header lists E. Rescorla (RTFM, Inc.) and N. Modadugu (Google, Inc.), Category: Standards Track, January 2012, with an ISSN line and “Obsoletes: 4347” and no Updates line; §8 "Changes since DTLS 1.0" enumerates the alignment with TLS 1.2, the new AEAD section and the rest.

zh: 与 TLS 1.2 对齐：以增量方式改写 TLS 1.2。
没有 DTLS 1.1：版本号跳过以与 TLS 同步。
AEAD 套件复用：与 TLS 1.2 完全一致地使用。
静默丢弃：无效记录的默认处置。
致命告警：一旦选择告警就必须 fatal。
epoch 复用限制：两倍 TCP MSL 内不得复用。
en: Aligned with TLS 1.2: presented as deltas on TLS 1.2.
No DTLS 1.1: the number was skipped to stay in step with TLS.
AEAD suites reused: usable exactly as in TLS 1.2.
Silent discard: the default handling of invalid records.
Fatal alerts only: if alerting, it must be fatal.
Epoch reuse limit: no reuse within twice the TCP maximum segment lifetime.
